question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: NVIDIA's recent next-quarter guides, which ran 11.5-14.5% (+$9.4B to +$11.8B) above the quarter just reported. Q3 was guided at $108B and NVIDIA beat its last two guides by about 4.6-5.7%, implying Q3 actual of roughly $113-114B. Applying a ~$10-14B step-up gives a Q4 guide of about $123-128B. Management said hyperscale growth reaccelerates in Q4 with the Vera Rubin ramp and expects Q4 gross margin to fall to 71-72%, consistent with a big new-product ramp. The fiscal-2028 forecast of 70% growth to about $690-700B implies fiscal 2027 near $405-420B, so Q4 revenue of about $120-130B. Supply constraints and the zero-China assumption make the guide conservative. Market check: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold contract on the Q4 guide; only a thin Manifold market on Q3 revenue (18 trades, 4 holders), centred on $110-114B, used as weak evidence only.
calls.dossier:
- Q1 FY27 (quarter ended Apr 26, 2026) revenue $81.6B; Q2 FY27 guide had been $91.0B +/-2% (NVIDIA press release / CNBC, May 20 2026).
- Q2 FY27 revenue $96.2B (+18% q/q, +106% y/y); data center $89.0B (stocktitan/NVIDIA PR, Aug 26 2026).
- Q3 FY27 guide: $108.0B +/-2% (range $105.8-110.2B), GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin 74.0% +/-50bp (NVIDIA PR, Aug 26 2026).
- From search-result summaries of the Aug 26 2026 call (the call transcript itself was not opened): Q3 growth driven mainly by data center ex-hyperscale; hyperscale growth expected to reaccelerate in Q4 and into FY28 as Vera Rubin supply grows.
- CFO: gross margin expected to decline to 71-72% in Q4 FY27, then 72-73% in FY28 as pricing increases take effect (Fortune/Yahoo, Aug 2026).
- First-ever year-ahead guide: FY28 revenue growth about 70% (reported as about $690-700B), described as supply-constrained; supply/capacity commitments rose from $119B to $279B (Fortune/Yahoo, Aug 2026).
- Outlook assumes no data-center compute revenue from China (NVIDIA Q1 FY27 PR).
- Prior guide step-ups over the just-reported quarter: Q1 FY27 guide $78.0B vs Q4 FY26 actual of about $68.1B (+$9.9B, figure from memory, not re-verified this run); Q2 guide $91.0B vs $81.6B (+$9.4B); Q3 guide $108.0B vs $96.2B (+$11.8B). Ratios 1.12-1.15.
- Beats vs guide midpoint: Q1 FY27 +$3.6B; Q2 FY27 +$5.2B.
- MarketBeat reports Q3 FY27 revenue consensus of about $111.3B, up 2.4% over a month; a separate search snippet gave a Q4 FY27 consensus of about $109B (range $105-116B) from 45 analysts, which conflicts with the $108B Q3 guide and looks stale or mislabeled.
- A small Manifold market on Q3 FY27 revenue (18 trades) puts most mass on $110-116B.
- Arithmetic check: FY28 ~$695B / 1.7 implies FY27 of about $409B; minus Q1-Q2 ($177.8B) and an assumed Q3 of about $113B leaves an implied Q4 of about $118B. A higher FY27 base raises that.
- Status quo: NVIDIA issues a single-point guide +/-2% for next-quarter revenue in its Q3 release/CFO commentary (expected Nov 17-18, 2026); resolves off the guide midpoint, not the actual.
- Event window: Q3 FY27 earnings release expected around Nov 17, 2026; as of Oct 11, 2026 the release has not happened.
- Searched, not found: any NVIDIA pre-announcement or explicit Q4 FY27 revenue commentary; a Polymarket/Kalshi market on the Q4 guide; any October 2026 export-control change.

calls.reconciliation: All runs agree on the facts (Q1 81.6/guide 78, Q2 96.2/guide 91, Q3 guide 108 ±2%, no China, no matching human market). The medians split 125 vs 127.5-128 on a judgment: dollar step-up vs percentage step-up. Unsettled factual points: the current Q4 FY27 consensus (the only figure found, ~$109B, is stale) and whether the $690-700B FY28 figure was a media calculation from an old FY27 consensus; I treated both as uncertain. I weighed the ratio method (supported by Q4 hyperscale reacceleration and price increases) against the consensus cross-check implying a lower Q4, and landed at $126B. I kept the runs' dispersion (~11) and gave about 5% each to both open tails.
